rows.text: receives **Notifications of Award from Power Grid Corporation of India for the OPGW-06 package**, the supply, execution and erection of optical ground wire on transmission lines at pan-India locations, an aggregate contract value of **Rs 82.42 crore**. The awards were issued on 24 August and signed on 9 September.

approves the **acquisition of 100% of Wire Brigade Industries from promoter-group Veritas Industries at Rs 21,500 per share**, discharged as 9,42,600 own shares at Rs 228 (Rs 21,49,12,800) plus Rs 86,000 in cash, inside a wider Rs 33,94,00,800 preferential issue.
